commentary.text: 90+6' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+3' Mallorca can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
90+2' Here is a change. Jaume Costa is going off and Javier Aguirre gives the last tactical orders to Toni Lato (Mallorca).
90+2' The substitution has been made. Oscar Rodriguez (Getafe) has replaced Borja Mayoral.
90+2' A substitution has been made. Juan Antonio Iglesias Sanchez is replaced by Luis Milla (Getafe).
90+1' Samu Costa (Mallorca) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
89' Javier Aguirre has decided to substitute Daniel Rodriguez and he is replaced by Pablo Maffeo (Mallorca).
89' The substitution is prepared. Manu Morlanes (Mallorca) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Omar Mascarell.
88' Jaume Costa (Mallorca) serves up a nice cross, but David Soria punches the ball away.
88' Diego Rico (Getafe) produces a dangerous low pass into the penalty area, but the defence manage to cut it out.
86' Mallorca keep the ball and are displaying some tiki-taka style passing at the moment.
84' Mason Greenwood (Getafe) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
82' A brilliant individual effort! Amath Ndiaye (Mallorca) tricks his way past challenges into the box and drags his shot narrowly wide of the right post.
79' Mason Greenwood (Getafe) picks up the ball and goes on a great solo run. He decides to shoot from mid-range but his attempt is comfortably blocked by a defender.
79' Diego Rico (Getafe) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
77' Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) does well to control a poor pass on the edge of the box then shoots towards the bottom left corner. David Soria is out of position but leaps to make a brilliant save.
75' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Jaime Mata (Getafe) was quite harsh and Pablo Gonzalez Fuertes didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
71' Substitution. Jose Angel Carmona makes way for Carles Alena (Getafe).
70' A rebound sits up perfectly for Daniel Rodriguez (Mallorca), who connects nicely with the ball from mid-range but sends it miles wide of the right post.
70' Daniel Rodriguez (Mallorca) will deliver the corner kick.
70' Cyle Larin (Mallorca) had a golden opportunity. He volleyed from point blank range towards the bottom right corner, but David Soria was alert and made an amazing save!
68' A cross from the free kick is whipped in by Mason Greenwood (Getafe), but one of the defenders steps in and averts the threat.
65' Javier Aguirre prepares a substitution. Antonio Sanchez is replaced by Amath Ndiaye (Mallorca).
65' We are about to witness a subsitution. Cyle Larin (Mallorca) for Abdon Prats.
63' A corner kick by Mallorca is thwarted by the well prepared David Soria (Getafe).
62' A snap shot by Samu Costa (Mallorca) from the edge of the area flies towards the left side of the goal, but David Soria produces a good save to thwart him.
60' Getafe force a corner. They send men into the box.
60' Jose Bordalas Jimenez has decided to make a change. Jaime Mata (Getafe) replaces Juanmi Latasa.
58' Mallorca take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
56' Abdon Prats (Mallorca) releases a decent shot towards the middle of the goal from the edge of the box, but it's comfortably gathered by David Soria.
54' So close! Samu Costa (Mallorca) tries a curler from the edge of the box, but it slides just wide of the left post.

53' Giovanni Alessandro Gonzalez Apud (Mallorca) produces an attempt from the edge of the box which would have most likely endangered the goalkeeper, but one of the defending players blocked it, so we can only speculate about the outcome.
52' Getafe are showing great team chemistry. They are passing the ball around seamlessly.
50' Jose Angel Carmona (Getafe) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
48' Diego Rico (Getafe) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
47' Looks like Diego Rico (Getafe) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+1' Pablo Gonzalez Fuertes has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) heads on.
43' Samu Costa (Mallorca) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
39' Mason Greenwood (Getafe) sends a cross into the box, but Predrag Rajkovic comes off his line to gather the ball.
39' Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) passes the ball onto Abdon Prats, but one of the defenders dispossesses him.
37' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Mallorca comes to nothing.
36' Mason Greenwood (Getafe) breaks into the box and goes over after a challenge from an opposition player, but the ref signals NO penalty!
34' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Mallorca.

33' What a great touch by Jose Angel Carmona (Getafe) as he controls a fine pass into the box and takes a shot to the right side of the goal, but an opposing player makes a clearance. Great defending.
31' Martin Valjent (Mallorca) plants a header from the edge of the box after a nice cross from the free kick. It lacks accuracy and the ball misses the left post by a few inches.
30' It seemed like Daniel Rodriguez (Mallorca) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
28' A bullet header by Daniel Rodriguez (Mallorca) from inside the box has the power, but goes totally in the wrong direction, yards over the crossbar.
25' Matija Nastasic (Mallorca) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Pablo Gonzalez Fuertes blows his whistle for a foul.
23' The linesman signals that Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
20' Samu Costa (Mallorca) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
18' Getafe have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
17' Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) rises high to meet a cross from the corner kick and plants a header from inside the penalty area. His effort went just narrowly wide of the left post.
17' The ball goes out of play. Mallorca are awarded a corner kick.
15' Daniel Rodriguez (Mallorca) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
12' Samu Costa (Mallorca) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Pablo Gonzalez Fuertes signals.
11' Mason Greenwood (Getafe) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
9' Some great controlled play and passing from Mallorca. They are increasing their possession of the ball and trying to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
6' Diego Rico (Getafe) sends the ball into the penalty area from a throw-in as if it's a corner kick.
3' A goal, which was scored by Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca), was disallowed due to offside.

The players are out at last! Mallorca will take the kick-off.
